verdict.rationale: Auth0's Private Cloud deployment docs explicitly reference meeting 'data-residency' requirements via dedicated, isolated AWS/Azure environments with Geo-HA add-ons, indicating some region/residency choice is possible, but this is tied to a specific enterprise deployment tier rather than a self-serve regional selection for all users. Missing for 10: concrete list of supported regions, details on standard (non-Private-Cloud) tenant region selection, and independent confirmation of residency guarantees.
